description: Form D history for one US company: every Form D (new offering) and D/A (amendment) it filed with the SEC, newest first, with amount sold, amount offered, number of investors and first sale date per filing. Answers "has this startup raised before, and how often?". Pass the CIK or the sec_url from get_rounds. Amounts are per filing and never summed (an amendment updates an earlier offering). Form D does not report valuation.
